About Fosterwold

Run by someone who works her own dogs

Fosterwold Gundogs is run by Katie Smith from the moor edge near Leyburn. Every dog that carries the Fosterwold name has done a day's work first — picking-up, beating, or standing steady at the peg — before it's ever considered for breeding.

Katie breeds working spaniels, HPRs and retrievers with one aim: a dog that's as reliable in the beating line on a Saturday as it is asleep by the fire on a Sunday. Litters are raised underfoot, started early, and never sold before they're ready.

“Work, trainability, temperament, health and looks — in that order. A dog has to earn its place before it earns a home.”
Katie Smith, Fosterwold Gundogs
